title: Rediscover Vietnam - A Complete Honeymoon Tour
highlights: From the bustling streets of Hanoi to the tranquil waterways of the Mekong Delta, experience the magic of Vietnam with your better half.
Experience the joy of cycling as you explore the countryside with a visit to the charming Bich Dong Pagoda.
Embark on a cruise through the Halong Bay, a UNESCO World Heritage Site and engage in Tai Chi martial art lessons on deck.
Create unforgettable memories with your loved one as you admire the iconic Lady Buddha statue at Linh Ung Pagoda and experience the thrill of rides at Fantasy Park.
Unleash your inner explorer in the 250-kilometre labyrinth of the Cu Chi Tunnels as you crawl through narrow passages and discover hidden bunkers.
overview:
About the tour:
Vietnam is a hub of beautiful landscapes and vibrant experiences. From the lush green rice terraces of Sa Pa to the pristine beaches of Nha Trang, the country boasts breathtaking natural beauty. Immerse yourself in the vibrant cities of Hanoi and Ho Chi Minh City, where ancient charm blends seamlessly with modern energy. Discover the timeless appeal of Hoi An, a UNESCO World Heritage site renowned for its lantern-lit streets and exquisite architecture. For an unforgettable adventure, cruise through the mesmerising Halong Bay, a UNESCO-listed wonder adorned with limestone karsts and emerald waters. Savour the rich flavours of Vietnamese cuisine, from the aromatic pho to the fresh seafood, while exploring bustling markets and interacting with warm-hearted locals.


Vietnam promises an unforgettable journey filled with discovery, relaxation, and cultural immersion. Whether you seek adventure, tranquillity, or a taste of city life, this Southeast Asian gem has it all.

know_before_you_go: Please note that prices are dynamic and may change in the peak season and on blackout dates.

ID Proof is mandatory for each individual guest at the time of booking, and upon arrival. PAN Card will not be considered as a valid identity proof. All foreign nationals must carry their passport as a proof of identity.
The official currency of Vietnam is the Vietnamese Dong (VND). It’s advisable to carry some cash for small purchases, though credit cards are widely accepted.
It is advisable that you dress modestly (keeping your upper arms and legs covered) when visiting any religious sites.
Indian tourists can obtain a Vietnam visa online (E-Visa) or upon arrival at the airport with a validity of 30 days. Charges have to be paid by the tourists.
Smoking is prohibited in most public areas therefore, designated smoking areas should be used.
Always carry tissue paper or wet wipes with you as most public toilets in Vietnam do not provide them.
To mitigate health risks, it is strongly advised to refrain from drinking tap water directly in Vietnam. Instead, carry refillable water bottles.
Images are only for representation purposes.

In cases of force majeure events (e.g., natural disasters, political unrest, or other unforeseeable circumstances), [Thrillophilia] reserves the right to reschedule tours & treks or offer alternative itineraries to ensure the safety and well-being of clients and staff.
Any breakage or damage of any items in the stay property will be charged at actuals.
Kindly do not litter and help keep the destinations clean.
Please note that the timings and duration of pick-up and drop-off transfers may vary based on certain factors like traffic, weather conditions, natural calamities, etc.
Prices may fluctuate with any change in services/hotels. The difference in the cost shall be borne by the client in case of any amendment in the package due to an increase in the number of guests.

If in case any traveller wants to or decides to leave the trip in the middle, all the expenses from the point onwards will be borne by the traveller. Neither the operator nor Thrillophilia will be held responsible for such decisions or for any refund.
It is recommended that you purchase travel insurance. Please note that the travel insurance is not included in the package price.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Hanoi | Leisure Day
days.desc: Welcome to Vietnam! Upon reaching the Noi Bai International Airport in Hanoi, get transferred to your hotel. Relax for a while and spend the rest of the day at leisure by exploring the local attractions on your own. Cross the iconic red Huc Bridge, known as the "Bridge of the Rising Sun," and immerse yourself in the heart of Hoan Kiem Lake. Also, witness the serene beauty of Ngoc Son Temple, a historic shrine located near the lake. Later, return to the hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

items.title: Check-in at Hm Boutique Hotel Hanoi at 02:00 PM

days.title: Excursion to Ninh Binh City
days.desc: Get ready for a sightseeing tour of Ninh Binh City as you get transferred for an excursion. Explore the ancient temples of Hoa Lu, once the capital of Vietnam and witness the architectural marvels dedicated to the nation’s founding kings. Cruise through Tam Coc, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, surrounded by towering limestone formations and lush greenery. Also, cycle through the beautiful countryside to reach Bich Dong Pagoda. Later, get dropped off at the hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Transfer to Halong Bay | Overnight Cruise
days.desc: Embark on a journey to Halong Bay as your check out from the hotel and take a pre-booked transfer. Board your cruise from Tuan Chau Harbour and set sail amidst the limestone karsts (rock formations). Explore Ti Top Island, visit the Pearl Farm Village, and enjoy water activities like kayaking and swimming. Learn the culinary secrets of Vietnamese cuisine with an onboard cooking class. Conclude the day with an overnight stay on the cruise, surrounded by the breathtaking beauty of Halong Bay.

days.title: Transfer to Da Nang | Leisure Day
days.desc: Begin your day with a rejuvenating Tai Chi martial art lesson on the cruise, followed by a visit to the Surprise Cave, adorned with stunning rock formations. Post that, deboard the cruise and get transferred to Noi Bai International Airport for your flight to Da Nang. Upon arriving at the Da Nang International Airport, get transferred to the hotel and check in for an overnight stay.

Experience a boat ride to the Surprise Cave, the largest caves in the Halong Bay and admire it's scenic beauty.
﻿Return to the cruise, relax and enjoy before reaching Taun Chan Bay.

days.title: Excursion to Ba Na Hills
days.desc: Embark on a thrilling adventure as you get transferred to Ba Na Hills. Soar above lush rainforests on a cable car ride, marvel at the architectural wonder of the Golden Hand Bridge, and learn about the wine making process at the Debay Wine Cellar. Admire the iconic Lady Buddha statue at Linh Ung Pagoda and experience the thrill of diverse rides at Fantasy Park. Conclude your day by getting dropped off at the hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Transfer to Ho Chi Minh City | Leisure Day
days.desc: On this day, check out from the hotel in Da Nang and get transferred to the Da Nang International Airport for your flight to Ho Chi Minh City. Upon arriving at the Tan Son Nhat International Airport, get transferred to the hotel to check in. Spend the rest of the day at leisure by exploring the local attractions on your own. You can visit the War Remnants Museum or go on a shopping spree at the Ben Thanh Market. Later, head back to the hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

days.title: Mekong Delta Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: Set off together with your partner on a journey to the Mekong Delta by boarding a pre-booked transfer. Experience the serenity of the Vinh Trang Pagoda, a renowned Buddhist shrine. Witness views of the lush greenery of Tortoise Island and cruise along the Mekong River from My Tho, watching the vibrant floating markets. En route, catch glimpses of the Turtle, Dragon, and Phoenix Islets. As the day concludes, get transferred to the hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Excursion to Cu Chi Tunnels
days.desc: Get ready and board your pre-booked transfer to explore the Cu Chi Tunnels, a testament to human resilience. Step into a 250-kilometre underground network, witnessing the creativity of the Vietnamese soldiers. Explore hidden bunkers, crawl through narrow passages, and learn about daily life during wartime. Following that, get transferred to the hotel for an overnight stay.
